name: FormGrid Self-Hosted Form Endpoints
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form endpoint API and dashboard; no vendor-enforced form or submission quota on software deployed on your own infrastructure.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker, MySQL and storage; email, object storage and hosting may incur costs. The software documents IP rate limiting (10 submissions/minute globally by default). Hosted FormGrid pricing is separate and not included.
